tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The appeal effect and subsequent refund for Income Tax cases for FY 2009-10 , FY 2012-13 , FY 2014-15 and FY 2015-16 , in which partial relief was provided to the Company by CIT (Appeals) vide order dated 22.03.24 , (approx Rs. 129 Cr. including interest) is yet to be received. The Income tax department had filed appeal with ITAT . For items which were not allowed as relief to the company, IREDA had furthur filed appeal before the ITAT (approx Rs. 14 Cr.). operating_notes.text: Accounts of ₹394.00 Cr are classified Stage III Standard instead of NPA under interim High Court orders, with interest recognised on collection basis.
Impairment on financial instruments for FY26 was ₹777.08 Cr against ₹237.23 Cr in FY25.
Company reported exchange fines of ₹2.03 lakh for non-compliance with SEBI LODR board and committee composition regulations for Q4 FY26.
Sanctions in Q1FY27 were ₹3,380 Cr against disbursements of ₹6,556 Cr.
Borrowings raised in Q1FY27 were ₹4,991 Cr; total borrowings ₹79,002 Cr, of which foreign borrowings ₹11,329 Cr and 83% of foreign borrowings hedged.
Private-sector loans were 77% of the ₹94,936 Cr loan book at 30 June 2026, against 73% at 31 March 2026.
Cumulative impairment allowance stood at ₹3,288.14 Cr as of September 30, 2026.
Gross loan portfolio was ₹97,411 Cr at 30 September 2026, with Telangana the largest state at 10.40% and Karnataka at 10.99%.
Foreign borrowings were ₹11,505 Cr at 30 September 2026, of which 82% was hedged.
Provision coverage ratio was 70.44% at 30 September 2026 against 63.88% at 31 March 2026.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,175.35 Cr (+14.2% YoY), net profit ₹492.63 Cr (-1.8% YoY).
In May 2026, IREDA disclosed stock exchange fines totalling ₹2.03 lakh for non-compliance with SEBI LODR board and committee composition requirements for Q4 FY26.
Q1FY27 (quarter ended 30 June 2026): standalone PAT ₹338 Cr, up 37% YoY, on revenue of ₹2,248 Cr; loan book ₹94,936 Cr, up 19%; gross NPA 3.76%.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,345.86 Cr (+14.0% YoY), net profit ₹552.17 Cr (+0.5% YoY).
IREDA published its Q2FY27 investor presentation detailing loan portfolio growth and borrowing profiles on October 19, 2026.
